

== Possibly faulty data ==
* Callsign/hometown: the archived decipher.com listing (cited on the Service row) gives Red 63, Lee on Solent, Hampshire, U.K., later London, U.K.; the fan Squadron Members table gives Red 63, Lee-on-the-Solent, UK. The article uses the Decipher listing. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 11:36, 14 October 2026 (UTC)
== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 1 July 2025. The Facebook photo viewer names Derek Hawkesworth. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 63 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Lee-on-the-Solent, UK). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/derek.hawkesworth (from Lee-on-the-Solent; University of Portsmouth; lives in Benalmádena, Spain). The uncropped original includes a child; the lead crop is Hawkesworth alone.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Derek Hawkesworth portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Derek Hawkesworth Facebook portrait.jpg]].
